_comment: Demo dataset seeded by `make seed-demo` (backend/src/bin/seed_demo.rs). All users share the password in `password`. Emails end @demo.nosdesk.test so the seeder can detect and skip an already-seeded instance. Timestamps are expressed as *_days_ago / *_hours_after offsets and backdated after insert. Reset with `make clean-db`, re-run onboarding, then re-run the seed.

projects.name: Laptop Refresh FY26
projects.description: Company-wide replacement of laptops older than three years, staged by department.

projects.name: Microsoft 365 Migration
projects.description: Migrate mailboxes, files, and collaboration off the legacy tenant into Microsoft 365.

projects.name: Network Upgrade, Building B
projects.description: Replace ageing switches and access points in Building B and remediate coverage gaps.

tickets.title: VPN drops every 30 minutes on home fibre
tickets.body_md:
Since Monday my VPN disconnects roughly every 30 minutes. It reconnects on its own but Teams calls drop and I lose access to the finance drive each time.

Home connection is fibre, no issues with anything else. Happy to run any diagnostics.

comments.author: priya
comments.body: Thanks Hannah. Can you grab the client logs next time it drops? Settings > VPN > Export diagnostics. I suspect an idle-timeout on the gateway.

comments.author: hannah
comments.body: Attached the logs from this morning's drop.

comments.author: priya
comments.body: Confirmed - the gateway is enforcing a 30-min rekey and the client isn't renewing silently. Rolling out an updated profile to the affected group.

tickets.title: Printer 3F-West jamming on duplex jobs
tickets.body_md: The floor 3 west printer jams on almost every double-sided job. Single-sided is fine. Paper is fresh from a sealed ream.

comments.author: marcus
comments.body: Sounds like the duplex roller. I'll come up and check the fuser and rollers this afternoon.

tickets.title: Password reset - locked out after holiday
tickets.body_md: I'm locked out after two weeks off. It says my password expired and the reset link isn't arriving.

comments.author: elena
comments.body: Reset done and forced a sync. You should be able to sign in now - you'll be prompted to set a new password.

comments.author: raj
comments.body: In now, thank you!

tickets.title: Laptop fan noise and overheating during Teams calls
tickets.body_md: My MacBook gets very hot and the fans spin up loudly whenever I'm in a Teams call for more than a few minutes. The bottom case is uncomfortable to touch.

comments.author: tom
comments.body: Teams is pinned at high CPU on the hardware-encode path for some M-series units. Try the browser client as a test while I check for the app update.

comments.author: sofia
comments.body: Browser client stays cool. So it does look like the app.

tickets.title: Request: second monitor for finance desk
tickets.body_md: Could I get a second monitor? Reconciliation work across spreadsheets on a single screen is slowing me down.

tickets.title: Outlook not syncing shared mailbox after migration
tickets.body_md: The `ops@` shared mailbox stopped syncing in Outlook after we moved to 365. New mail only shows up on the web, not the desktop app. Removing and re-adding the account didn't help.

comments.author: priya
comments.body: Automapping is stale post-migration. I'll remove the auto-mapped entry and re-add the mailbox manually - that usually forces a clean resync.

tickets.title: Disk almost full warning on LT-0043
tickets.body_md: Getting 'low disk space' warnings constantly. Only 2 GB free. Not sure what's eating it.

comments.author: marcus
comments.body: Teams cache and old Windows update files were 40 GB combined. Cleared them and enabled Storage Sense. You've got 180 GB free now.

tickets.title: MFA enrolment fails on new phone
tickets.body_md: Got a new phone and the Authenticator app won't enrol - the QR scan just spins and times out. Old phone is wiped so I can't approve from it.

comments.author: elena
comments.body: I reset your MFA methods so the old device won't block enrolment. Re-scan the QR now and it should take.

comments.author: liam
comments.body: Enrolled. Thanks Elena.

tickets.title: New starter onboarding: accounts + laptop (N. Bennett)
tickets.body_md:
New Operations Lead starting Monday. Needs:

- AD account + email
- Laptop (standard Ops build)
- Access to the Ops shared drive and Building B systems
- Building B door badge

comments.author: priya
comments.body: Account created, laptop LT-0052 imaged and assigned, drive + Building B access granted. Badge request sent to facilities.

comments.author: sofia
comments.body: Perfect, all set for Monday.

tickets.title: Wi-Fi dead zone in Building B kitchen
tickets.body_md: No usable Wi-Fi in the Building B kitchen and breakout area. Signal drops to nothing about halfway down the corridor. Several people can't take calls there.

comments.author: tom
comments.body: Survey confirmed the gap. New AP (NET-APB2K) is on order for the kitchen; cabling run scheduled with the install wave.

tickets.title: Software install request: Adobe Illustrator
tickets.body_md: I need Illustrator for the new hire welcome packs. A single named license is fine.

comments.author: marcus
comments.body: License approved and assigned. Illustrator is pushed to your Mac via self-service - open Company Portal and install.

tickets.title: Phishing email reported - please verify
tickets.body_md: Got an email claiming to be from Finance asking me to 'confirm payroll details' via a link. The sender domain looks slightly off. I did not click. Reporting it to be safe.

comments.author: elena
comments.body: Good catch - it's a lookalike domain, not us. I've blocked the sender tenant-wide and purged the message from all mailboxes. No clicks recorded.

comments.author: elena
comments.body: Flagging for the monthly security summary.

tickets.title: Teams audio cuts out in Meeting Room Apollo
tickets.body_md: In Apollo the room mic keeps cutting out mid-sentence on Teams calls. Remote attendees say we vanish for a few seconds at a time. Video is fine.

comments.author: tom
comments.body: Firmware on the Rally Bar is a version behind and there's a known mic-dropout fix. Scheduling the update for after hours so I don't interrupt a meeting.

tickets.title: Cannot access shared finance drive
tickets.body_md: I've lost access to the Finance shared drive this morning - it says permission denied. It was working yesterday. Nothing changed on my end.

comments.author: priya
comments.body: A group cleanup overnight dropped you from the Finance security group by mistake. Re-added you and confirmed access. Sorry about that.

tickets.title: Screen flickering on MacBook Pro
tickets.body_md: The screen flickers intermittently, mostly on dark backgrounds. Restarting helps for a while then it comes back.

tickets.title: Request: standing desk and docking station
tickets.body_md: Could I get a sit-stand desk and a docking station for my laptop? Occupational health suggested it.

tickets.title: Email delivery delayed to external clients
tickets.body_md: Several clients report our replies arriving hours late. Internal mail is instant. This started during the pilot migration and is hurting deals in flight.

comments.author: marcus
comments.body: Outbound was routing through the old connector and getting greylisted. Repointed the send connector to 365 and delivery is back to seconds.

comments.author: liam
comments.body: Confirmed with two clients - replies are instant again.

tickets.title: OneDrive sync errors after migration
tickets.body_md: OneDrive shows a red X and 'sync pending' on dozens of files since the rollout. Some documents won't open because they're 'still uploading'.

comments.author: priya
comments.body: A few filenames have characters 365 rejects (colons and trailing spaces). I'll send a list to rename, then reset the sync client.

tickets.title: Keyboard keys sticking on LT-0051
tickets.body_md: The E and R keys stick and sometimes double-type. Cleaning didn't help.

comments.author: marcus
comments.body: Under warranty - logged a depot repair. Loaner is at reception for you in the meantime.

tickets.title: Zoom to Teams migration - training request
tickets.body_md: Now that we're standardising on Teams, could the Sales team get a short training session on meetings, channels, and calling?

tickets.title: VPN certificate expired warning
tickets.body_md: Connecting to VPN now throws a certificate expired warning. I can click through but it feels wrong - wanted to flag it.

comments.author: elena
comments.body: The gateway cert renewed but the client trust bundle was stale. Pushed the updated bundle - reconnect and the warning is gone. Don't click through cert warnings in future, good instinct to report it.

tickets.title: Meeting Room Zephyr display won't wake
tickets.body_md: The Zephyr room display stays black. Remote and power cycling the panel does nothing. Room is unusable for presentations.

comments.author: tom
comments.body: HDMI handshake between the Studio X50 and the panel was stuck. Swapped the cable and set the panel to always-on. Working now.

tickets.title: Request new laptop - cracked screen (H. Brooks)
tickets.body_md: I dropped my laptop and the screen is badly cracked - about a third is unreadable. I can still work on an external monitor but it's not practical for meetings.

comments.author: priya
comments.body: You're due in the refresh anyway, so I'll bring your replacement forward into Wave 2 rather than repair. New unit is being imaged now.

tickets.title: Slow login on shared reception PC
tickets.body_md: The reception PC takes 4-5 minutes to get to the desktop after sign-in. It's awkward when visitors are waiting.

tickets.title: Spam getting through to sales inbox
tickets.body_md: The sales@ inbox is getting 20-30 obvious spam messages a day past the filter this week. Some are convincing fake RFQs.

comments.author: elena
comments.body: There's a new campaign hitting shared inboxes. I've tightened the policy and added the top offending domains. Forward anything that still slips through and I'll tune it.

tickets.title: Access request: HR folder for new manager
tickets.body_md: New HR manager needs read/write to the HR Confidential folder. Approved by the HR Director.

comments.author: priya
comments.body: Access granted and verified. Logged the approver for the audit trail.

tickets.title: Printer 2F-East out of toner, order replacement
tickets.body_md: The 2F east printer is out of black toner and there's no spare in the cabinet. Please order a replacement cartridge.

comments.author: marcus
comments.body: Ordered a cartridge plus one spare for the cabinet. ETA two business days.

tickets.title: Laptop won't charge - possible bad adapter
tickets.body_md: My MacBook stopped charging. No light on the connector, tried both USB-C ports. Battery is at 4%.

comments.author: tom
comments.body: The charger is dead - it doesn't power a test unit either. Swapped you a new 96W adapter and cable. Working now. Left the old one for e-waste.

tickets.title: Request: bulk password policy review
tickets.body_md: Can we review the password policy? Some of us are prompted to change far more often than others and it's causing confusion.

tickets.title: Switch B-1 port flapping - network drops in Building B
tickets.body_md: Building B keeps losing network for 10-20 seconds at a time, several times an hour. Affects everyone on that floor. Started yesterday afternoon.

comments.author: tom
comments.body: Uplink port on Switch B-1 is flapping - logs show link up/down every few minutes. Moving the uplink to a spare port now and will replace the SFP.

comments.author: noah
comments.body: Much better since lunchtime, no drops so far.

comments.author: tom
comments.body: Keeping this open until the replacement switch lands in the install wave - the whole unit is due for swap.

tickets.title: Cannot join Teams meeting - camera not detected
tickets.body_md: Teams says 'no camera found' but the camera works in Photos. Reinstalling Teams didn't fix it.

comments.author: elena
comments.body: Camera privacy permission for Teams got reset in the last Windows update. Re-enabled it under Privacy > Camera and it's detected now.

tickets.title: SharePoint permissions wrong after migration
tickets.body_md: After the rollout, the whole Sales team can see the Deals Confidential SharePoint library. It should be restricted to directors only. This is sensitive - please fix urgently.

comments.author: priya
comments.body: Confirmed - broken inheritance during migration re-granted the parent group. I've removed the inherited access and restored the directors-only permission. Auditing who accessed it in the window.

comments.author: elena
comments.body: Access logs show no downloads by non-directors during the exposure window. Documenting for the security record.

tickets.title: Request: additional software license (Photoshop)
tickets.body_md: Marketing asked me to help with some image edits. Could I get a Photoshop license added to my Creative Cloud?

comments.author: marcus
comments.body: Approved and assigned. Sign out and back into Creative Cloud to pick up Photoshop.

tickets.title: Laptop stuck on Windows update loop
tickets.body_md: My laptop has been 'restarting to finish updates' for two hours, cycling the same percentage. I can't get to the desktop.

comments.author: tom
comments.body: A cumulative update was failing to apply and rolling back on loop. Booted to recovery, cleared the pending update, and reapplied cleanly. All your files are intact.

tickets.title: Guest Wi-Fi password rotation request
tickets.body_md: We've got a client visit next week - can we rotate the guest Wi-Fi password and send me the new one for the welcome sheet?

comments.author: elena
comments.body: Rotated. New password sent to you separately. It'll be live from tomorrow morning.

tickets.title: Duplicate calendar invites after migration
tickets.body_md: Since the rollout every meeting shows up two or three times in my calendar. Accepting one doesn't clear the others.

comments.author: marcus
comments.body: A leftover calendar sync from the old tenant was duplicating events. Removed it and cleaned the duplicates. Let me know if any stragglers remain.

tickets.title: Request: encrypted USB drives for finance
tickets.body_md: Finance occasionally needs to hand-carry sensitive files to auditors. Could we get a few hardware-encrypted USB drives that meet policy?

tickets.title: Account lockout - repeated failed logins from unknown IP
tickets.body_md: I keep getting locked out and I'm not the one entering the wrong password. Got an alert about sign-in attempts from a country I've never been to.

comments.author: elena
comments.body: Confirmed a password-spray against your account from a foreign IP. MFA held and nothing got in. I've reset your password, revoked active sessions, and blocked the source range. You're safe - please set a new unique password now.

comments.author: elena
comments.body: Opening a follow-up to check whether other accounts were targeted in the same wave.

tickets.title: Old laptop decommission and data wipe (LT-0043)
tickets.body_md: Raj's old laptop from before the refresh needs a certified wipe and to be removed from asset inventory before it goes to recycling.

comments.author: priya
comments.body: Certified wipe completed, certificate filed, asset marked decommissioned. Ready for the recycler pickup.

tickets.title: New monitor arm mount install request
tickets.body_md: Could someone mount a monitor arm on my desk? I have the arm, just need it fitted to the desk edge.

comments.author: sofia
comments.body: Never mind - facilities sorted it during the desk move. Please close.

tickets.title: Cannot print to Building B printers over VPN
tickets.body_md: When I'm on VPN from home I can't see or print to any Building B printers. In the office it's fine. Several of the Ops team have the same issue.

comments.author: tom
comments.body: The print subnet isn't in the split-tunnel routes for the VPN. I'll add the Building B print range to the profile.

tickets.title: Teams status stuck on Away
tickets.body_md: My Teams status shows 'Away' even when I'm actively typing. Colleagues think I'm offline. Setting it manually to Available doesn't stick.

comments.author: marcus
comments.body: Known presence bug when Teams and Outlook disagree on idle. Cleared the Teams cache and it's tracking correctly now.

tickets.title: Request: shared mailbox for support team
tickets.body_md: Can we set up a shared `itsupport@` mailbox so requests don't land in one person's inbox while they're out?

comments.author: priya
comments.body: Good idea. Draft mailbox created for review - deciding on membership and whether replies send as the shared address before we go live.

tickets.title: Malware alert on reception PC - please investigate
tickets.body_md: The antivirus popped a threat alert on the reception PC and quarantined something. The machine feels sluggish. Flagging urgently since it's a shared, semi-public device.

comments.author: elena
comments.body: Quarantine caught a browser-extension adware bundle - not a real compromise. Removed the extension, ran a full scan (clean), and locked down extension installs on that machine. Sluggishness is gone.

tickets.title: Slow file transfers to Building B server
tickets.body_md: Copying files to the Building B file server is crawling - a 500 MB folder takes 20+ minutes. From Building A it's fine.

tickets.title: Request: onboarding checklist automation
tickets.body_md: Could we automate the new-starter checklist? Right now it's a manual list we copy each time and things get missed.

comments.author: priya
comments.body: Parking this for now - it overlaps with the HRIS rollout that will own onboarding workflows next quarter. Closing so it doesn't sit stale; we'll revisit as part of that project.

tickets.title: Docking station not detecting external monitors
tickets.body_md: My dock stopped driving the two external monitors - laptop screen works but the externals stay black. Reseating cables didn't help.

comments.author: tom
comments.body: The dock's firmware needed an update and one DisplayPort output had failed. Updated it and swapped the dock - both monitors are back.

tickets.title: Email signature not applying firmwide
tickets.body_md: The standardised email signature we agreed for the pilot group isn't appearing on sent mail for some users. It's inconsistent - works for a few, not for others.

comments.author: marcus
comments.body: The transport rule only applied to external mail and skipped users with a local signature set. Adjusted the rule scope and cleared local overrides for the pilot group - consistent now.
